$description: Anticipation tokens - Disney's principle of preparation before action. Wind-up motion opposite to intended direction.

anticipation.$description: Wind-up parameters: scale, offset, and duration before main action

micro.$description: Barely perceptible anticipation. Micro-interactions, toggles. Subtle professionalism.

small.$description: Noticeable but quick anticipation. Buttons, icons, small UI elements.

medium.$description: Standard anticipation for cards, modals, medium components.

dramatic.$description: Pronounced wind-up for hero moments, celebrations, dramatic reveals.

extreme.$description: Maximum anticipation for cartoon-style animations, gaming, playful brands.

direction-patterns.$description: Anticipation offset direction relative to main action

vertical-up.$description: Crouch before jump. Pull down before popping up.

vertical-down.$description: Rise before drop. Used for gravity-assisted actions.

horizontal-left.$description: Pull right before moving left. Slide-in from left.

horizontal-right.$description: Pull left before moving right. Slide-in from right.

scale-down.$description: Swell before shrinking. Emphasis before disappear.

timing-ratios.$description: Anticipation duration as percentage of total animation

standard.$description: Balanced anticipation. Most UI use cases.

dramatic.$description: Long wind-up for maximum impact. Hero moments only.

wind-up.$description: Ease-out into anticipation position. Smooth deceleration to wind-up.

spring-back.$description: Spring-like release from anticipation into action. Overshoots slightly.
